# Game Design

## Overview

The game is a simple text-based adventure game where the player can move around a grid-based map, interact with non-player characters (NPCs), collect items, and engage in combat.

## Game Structure

The game will be structured into the following components:

### Game Loop

The game loop will run continuously until the player quits the game. The loop will consist of the following steps:

3. Handle user input

6. Repeat from step 1
